scope: M11 phase C calculations from config/robot.json m10.electronics and the phase A requirements; a digital design check, not a hardware measurement

electronics_config.status: M11 phase C electrical design (18 October 2026): parts signed off in phase B; calculations in bipe/m11/power.py. Digital design only, not hardware-validated

drivers.bulk_capacitance_basis: 12 x 4.7 uF 100 V MLCC (mjbots/moteus hw/c1/bulk_capacitance.kicad_sch); nominal, no DC-bias derating
drivers.logic_power_basis: Not published; STM32G4, gate driver and MAX15062 buck. Assumption to be measured on the bench
drivers.settings_basis: max_voltage at least 5 V above the 25.2 V full pack (mjbots electrical setup guide); regen limit above the 5.7 W phase A driver peak

can.termination: split 2 x 60 ohm with 4.7 nF to ground at both bus ends

host.model: PJRC Teensy 4.0 on a custom 2-layer carrier
host.basis: about 100 mA at 600 MHz (pjrc.com/store/teensy40.html); CAN3 (FD) on bottom pads 30/31

can_transceiver.basis: Phase D: replaces the TCAN330G, which LCSC does not stock (MCP2562FD: about 1.5k in stock, $1.71). Datasheet DS20005284A: CAN FD to 8 Mbps; VDD 4.5-5.5 V; IDD 45 mA typ / 70 mA max dominant, 10 mA max recessive; VIO 1.8-5.5 V; STBY high = standby

imu.basis: high-performance mode, both sensors on (assumed from the LSM6DSO family datasheet)

vision_reservation.model: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the head Camera Module 3
vision_reservation.basis: Zero 2 W: 350 mA typical bare-board active, 2 A recommended supply (raspberrypi.com documentation power table); reserved, not wired to the controller

regulator_5V.basis: Retailer specifications (e.g. racedayquads.com); chosen over the Pololu D36V28F5 (3.2 A, 17.8 x 20.3 x 8.8 mm) for the 5 V peak with the vision reservation

soft_start.controller: TI LM5060 high-side protection controller with an external N-channel MOSFET
soft_start.enable: EN from the shell power switch (microamp signal current)
soft_start.ovp: OVP pin to GND (not used, as the datasheet allows; the pack is the only source)
soft_start.timer_basis: LM5060 SNVS628H: ITIMERL 4/6/7 uA, ITIMERH 8.5/11/13 uA, VTMRH 2.0 V typ (no limits given; +/-6% assumed), VTMRL 0.3 V, VGATE-TH 3.5/5/6.5 V; ISENSE 13.6/16/18 uA, VOFFSET +/-7 mV

mosfet.source: https://www.aosmd.com/res/datasheets/AOD4184A.pdf (Rev 1.0, September 2023); SOA and single-pulse power are rated at a 25 C case. LCSC C99124: about 6k in stock, $0.30

soft_start.basis: LM5060 datasheet SNVS628H: IGATE 17/24/31 uA, IGATE-OFF 2.2 mA, IGATE-FLT 80 mA, UVLO 1.6 V; output rise time set by a GATE-to-GND capacitor

mosfet_requirements.basis: Ramp energy 0.16-0.21 J over 18-33 ms (bipe/m11/power.py); the part is chosen in phase D from stocked 40 V N-channel MOSFETs against its single-pulse SOA

fuse.model: Littelfuse MINI 297 series 10 A (0297010.WXNV) in a PCB holder
fuse.basis: Littelfuse MINI blade fuse datasheet: 32 VDC, 1000 A interrupting; the 0451 Nano2 10 A interrupts only 400 A at 32 V

pack.basis: 3.2 V/cell arm minimum and 3.0 V/cell cutoff (M4 config/electronics.json limits); internal resistance is an assumption for 850 mAh packs

wiring.basis: Annealed copper AWG resistance at 20 C; lengths are layout estimates for phase D

firmware.status: M11 phase E firmware hardware layer: digital design, values marked assumption or commissioning are measured on hardware
firmware.driver_ids_basis: moteus id.id per driver, keyed by the plant's JOINTS and WHEELS names
firmware.timeout_basis: User decision 19 October 2026: after 20 ms (4 control periods) without a command the joints damp in moteus zero-velocity mode (12) and the wheels stop (0, limp). The 0.5 N*m damping cap is about a third of the 1.65 N*m joint command cap, to tune on the bench

imu.basis: ST DS12140 Rev 3 (June 2024): WHO_AM_I 6Ch; CTRL3_C BDU + IF_INC (44h); CTRL1_XL 1.66 kHz, +-4 g (88h); CTRL2_G 1.66 kHz, +-500 dps (84h); INT1_CTRL INT1_DRDY_G (02h); outputs OUTX_L_G (22h) to OUTZ_H_A (2Dh); typical sensitivities 0.122 mg/LSB and 17.50 mdps/LSB; SPI mode 3, clock at most 10 MHz. Axes from Figure 3 (top view: pin 1 top left, X right, Y up, Z out of the top face)

timing.basis: Driver turnaround (CAN receive to reply start) and Teensy compute time are assumptions for the bench check with the DWT cycle counter; the compute bound is at least 10 x the host-measured estimator and controller step (artifacts/m11/firmware/timing.json)

carrier.basis: Teensy carrier in the probed host slot (x -14 to 26, y 13.9 to 23.9 mm), at z 5.5 to 35.5 mm: 0.5 mm below the cover and 0.5 mm above the inner shaft (cad/m11/adoption_check.py); KiCad origin at the bottom -x corner (KiCad y runs up the body), front facing +y so the top-entry PH plugs exit into the clear space at y 23.9-36 mm (the -y side holds the knee pulley and belt, the edges the knee shaft and cover); Teensy USB at the +x edge facing the battery bay

power.basis: Power board in the probed rear-low slot (x -82 to -73, y -30 to 30, z -33.5 to -13.5 mm); PCB back at x -82, components face the body interior; the top-entry PH plugs and soldered leads exit +x into the clear gap at x -73 to -66 mm (the tub floor sits 2.5 mm below the board)

boards.frame: origin_body_m is the KiCad (0, 0) corner on the board's back face; board points map as origin + x board_x_axis + y board_y_axis + height front_normal, the height measured from the back face

component_heights_m.basis: Package maximum heights above the board front from the datasheets (LSM6DSO 0.86, SOIC-8 1.75, SOT-23-5 1.45, SOT-23 1.12, TO-252 2.39, SMB 2.44, VSSOP-10 1.1 mm; MLCC and resistor maxima by size). PH headers carry the mated plug: JST ePH catalog, 8.0 mm high after mounting. Teensy 4.0 on 2.5 mm header spacers, 4.0 mm for its board, parts and micro-USB above them (assumption)

harness.assignment: Hub c1s are the two boards beside the battery (nearest the body ports at y +/-24 mm); the four motor-row boards drive the RO40s

wires.basis: User decision 18 October 2026 (thin-wall PTFE). ODs from distributor listings of the Alpha Wire parts (2843/7 0.79 mm, 2841/7 0.61 mm) and Adafruit 1970 (1.4 +/- 0.1 mm); strand diameters from the AWG stranding codes

harness.route_basis: Gallery, shin channel and axle tube from the CAD envelopes (artifacts/m11/harness/geometry_0.103.json); body run 1.5 x the 41 mm straight line from the side board to the body port; inner-shaft bore from the body port (y 24 mm) to the gallery (y 72.5 mm)
harness.service_loop_basis: User decision 18 October 2026: service loops of radius 10 mm or more at the rotating crossings; strand strain is reported, fatigue life is a bench cycle test

encoder.supply_basis: AS5047P supply current, distributor catalog attribute (RS 2009463); the ams datasheet download is restricted
encoder.spi_rate_basis: moteus aux[12].spi.rate_hz defaults to 12 MHz, above the AS5047P 10 MHz maximum; 2 MHz for the 0.32 m hub runs (a 16-bit frame takes 8 us)

runtime.basis: draw scenario (0.85 inverter efficiency, 125 C copper), 80% of 0.85 Ah x 22.2 V

soft_start.turn_off_basis: GATE-to-GND capacitor plus about 3 nF MOSFET input capacitance, discharged from VIN + 12 V at IGATE-OFF 2.2 mA
soft_start.inrush_limit_basis: Inrush below 1 A: under 15% of the 6.6 A phase A peak and far below the fuse rating

uvlo.placement: The shell switch connects the top of the UVLO divider (and EN) to the pack, so the off-state drain is the LM5060 disabled current only (<15 uA)
uvlo.basis: LM5060 UVLO 1.6 V rising, 180 mV hysteresis, 5.5 uA pull-down (typical)

fuse_and_wiring.fuse: Littelfuse MINI 297 series 10 A (0297010.WXNV) in a PCB holder
fuse_and_wiring.short_circuit_basis: Full pack across the pack resistance (assumed per-cell value), the trunk and the connectors; this ignores the MOSFET, so it is an upper estimate

lm5060.basis: Gate path: C_gate plus Ciss (to the plateau and after the ramp) or Crss (during the ramp) at IGATE 17 uA. The MOSFET single-pulse rating is for a 25 C case, so the check keeps half of it; the junction rise uses RthJC because the ramps last 18-33 ms

overvoltage.finding: While the pack is plugged in it absorbs regenerated energy, even with the switch off: the high-side N-MOSFET's body diode conducts from the bus back to the pack (phase A: the bus never regenerates in operation). Only an unplugged pack or a blown fuse leaves the bus capacitance alone; braking energy would then lift it far above max_voltage, so flux braking (above the brake point) must absorb it.
overvoltage.back_emf_basis: Hub back-EMF Ke w equals the 19.2 V low pack voltage at this ground speed; below it a back-driven hub cannot charge the bus through the driver body diodes

battery_monitor.placement: On the switched bus, so it draws nothing when the robot is off

fault_table.response: LM5060 pulls GATE low at 80 mA (5 us); the 10 A MINI fuse interrupts if the MOSFET fails short
LM5060 rise time 15-33 ms holds inrush below 0.5 A; XT30s are never hot-plugged

fault_table.detection: Teensy bus ADC and moteus bus voltage; LM5060 UVLO
fault_table.response: Firmware stops and disarms at 18.0 V (3.0 V/cell); the UVLO opens the switch near 2.9 V/cell as a hardware backstop
Flux braking above 27 V; moteus faults at 30 V; regen power limited to 10 W per driver
Prevented by the keyed XT30; the moteus has no reverse protection
moteus stops on command timeout; the supervisor latches a stop
LED brightness capped in firmware; the vision host is reserved within the 5 A rating
